events.title: Scenario: Data-center growth increases substation loading in major metro corridors
events.summary: Concentrated data-center growth may create near-term substation loading pressure that forces reprioritization of transformer procurement and deployments in constrained metro areas.

events.title: Scenario: Spare-parts tightness for HV transformers increases retrofit risk
events.summary: Spare-part scarcity for HV transformers may elevate outage duration risk during clustered maintenance or failure events, pressuring retrofit planning and budgets.

events.title: Signal: Increased procurement of inverters and power electronics for renewable integration
events.summary: Growing inverter and power-electronics procurement for renewables and storage could create component supply pressure that delays project commissioning.

events.title: Scenario: Competing demand for copper and lithium tightens sourcing windows
events.summary: Converging copper and lithium demand across power and transport sectors could compress supplier capacity and raise procurement risk for grid and storage projects.

events.title: Signal: Data centers accelerate adoption of on-site storage and microgrids for resilience
events.summary: Data centers shifting toward on-site storage and microgrids may ease immediate grid upgrade needs locally but increase demand for batteries, inverters, and integration services.

events.title: Signal: Modular substation procurement gaining traction to shorten delivery
events.summary: Modular substations may shorten project timelines but concentrate risk around module suppliers and standards.

events.title: Signal: Insurance and finance conditions beginning to price grid resilience differently
events.summary: Insurance and finance market adjustments toward resilience may re-orient capital flows to projects that lower outage risk but could increase costs for exposed assets.

events.title: Signal: Predictive maintenance AI increases sensor and analytics demand
events.summary: AI-driven predictive maintenance may lower outage risk over time but increases near-term demand for sensors, software, and skilled staff, creating new supply and labor pinch points.

events.title: Signal: Distribution transformer retrofit programs accelerating for EV readiness
events.summary: Accelerated distribution transformer retrofit programs for EV readiness could stress transformer and copper supply if implementation is clustered.

events.title: Signal: Emerging demand for interoperability standards in inverter and microgrid controls
events.summary: Interoperability standards for inverters and microgrid controls are becoming a gating factor for rapid, multi-vendor deployments.
